answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 44220 Country: India Title: Black magic Question: I have a cousin who lives in village and I have a feeling that he is doing black magic on our family. My dad always takes his side and my dad is ready to help him financially. My dad does not believe in black magic. My dad wasn't talking to me properly for few days. My dad talks to him every day. 18 months back I found 11 rice grains in my purse after his wife left our place. I always fall ill during my exams and also every year in February and March. I have gone for blood test many times but no disease or problem is diagnosed. Please guide me through this difficulty. Answer ID: 44220 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 413/325/B=1434) It is not a sign of black magic to fall ill during exam days. A man falls ill due to extra burden and the tension of exam as well. It is not a sign of black magic to get rice in your purse. All is your imagination. A Muslim should talk reality and truth only. If you consider so then you will be caught in this doubt throughout your life and will not get rid of it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
